scope: Apply the same bounded row catalogue to rectangular parts in the opt-in search. Use original outlines, stock, rotations, quantities, clearance and whole-layout acceptance checks.

pilot.required: All 72 layouts valid and all eight matched three-seed bonus material medians within +1% of ordinary.

confirmation: If the pilot passes, run the separate full 234-layout development matrix. Require all layouts valid, median cut savings >=10% at each kerf, and material change <=+1% in every one of the 26 comparisons. Verify archived original/exported geometry and public surfaces.
